body:
On some further insight, I think this bug is actually caused by how NextJS exports its packages.

Take `document` for example: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/document.js

compare outputs of:
`console.log(require('next/document.js'))`
and `import('next/document.js').then(console.log)`

On the `import` the default is being overridden with a full object, instead of just Document

This is expected behavior in NodeJS https://nodejs.org/api/esm.html#esm_import_statements

I don't think it is possible for CJS to actually export _both_ a default and named exports, so values like `Document` should get a named export as well, so files loading it can just reference the named export instead.

e.g. `import { Document } from 'next/document.js'`

issue.title: Export defaults as named exports
issue.body:
Provides a workaround for default exports not working in CJS -> ESM

fixes https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/23029

Added for all the `.js` files [here](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/canary/packages/next)

With _exception_ of 
* amp - no default export
* babel - proper default export
* client - couldn't find recommended usage of file for a good name to use...
* data - I can't find the file?
* router - default export doesn't have recommended usage
* taskfiles - proper default export, or I couldn't find recommended usage of file to get good name

issue.title: Issue with backend-side ES6 imports with "type":"module" with an express/nextjs setup

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
Hi, Next.js has added native ESM support in Next 12. Please give it a try.

https://nextjs.org/blog/next-12#es-modules-support-and-url-imports

@balazsorban44 I have updated the example code provided to next12.

The bug still exists.

NextJS does not support writing code as ES modules yet, it only supports importing those files from third parties.

Fingers crossed this sort of issue will be resolved by features like https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/33637 or via the solution I provided above

But until then I would appreciate keeping this issue open as it has not been resolved

issue.title: Add support for "type": "module" in package.json
